summary: Iteration 2 retest. Backend: 30 pytest tests (23 regression + 7 new): 29/30 pass. Fixes verified: (1) Closing a campaign auto-rejects direview/menunggu_views/diproses submissions with note 'Campaign ditutup', notifies creators, refunds the full budget, and blocks later verify/claim/review (400). Refund + payout <= budget, so no over-payout. (2) Verify returns 409 and reverts the lock to 'diproses' when the campaign is closed (simulated race). It also reverts when the campaign doc is missing. (3) URL normalization rejects query/trailing-slash/www/m/host-case/http/fragment variants and stores 'https://tiktok.com/@u/video/ID'. (4) Bearer logout deletes the session (/auth/me returns 401 afterwards). (5) Komerce callback: 401 without a header or with a bad header, 200 with HMAC(body) or the raw callback_key, 404 for an unknown payment. It re-confirms with the sandbox (still pending), so nothing is credited. (6) Full submission and withdrawal flows plus sandbox QRIS/VA topups regressed OK. NEW BUG: the URL normalization strips the query string, so every youtube.com/watch?v=ID becomes 'https://youtube.com/watch'. The second distinct YouTube watch video is rejected as a duplicate. UI checks (Playwright): calculator slider track is white/20 with an orange range (rgb 255,85,0) and the value updates. At 390px the hero role toggle labels are one line each (48px height) with no horizontal overflow. In the topup result (VA BNI, desktop and 390px), the payment link and status badge are stacked with a 16px gap. 'Cek status' toast says 'Pembayaran belum diterima'. All test data cleaned up (public payouts now []).

critical.issue: Stripping the whole query string collapses all YouTube watch URLs (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XXX) to 'https://youtube.com/watch'. After the first one, every other YouTube watch video is rejected with 'Video ini sudah pernah didaftarkan'. The unique index on video_url enforces this too. Fix: keep the 'v' param for youtube.com/watch (or map it to youtu.be/ID / youtube.com/shorts/ID canonical form). Consider unifying youtu.be/ID with youtube.com/watch?v=ID. Test: TestUrlNormalization::test_youtube_watch_distinct_videos

minor.issue: When the budget is exhausted, the campaign is set to 'closed', but other direview/menunggu_views/diproses submissions on it are NOT auto-rejected. They get stuck forever: claim returns 400, verify returns 409, review can still approve, and brand stats show 'Perlu direview' permanently. Reproduced: the TEST_Campaign submission stayed 'direview' after auto-close. Reuse the close auto-reject logic here.
Doesn't check the campaign status, so a brand/admin can approve content on a closed campaign. The submission then moves to menunggu_views, which can never be claimed.

A submission that is mid-verify ('verifying') at close time is not included in the auto-reject. Verify then fails with 409 and reverts to 'diproses' on a closed campaign, so it's stuck. Edge race; include 'verifying' or reject on 409 when the campaign is closed.

issues: The 'Saldo brand' stat value 'Rp 700.000' wraps onto 2 lines in the half-width card. Reduce the font size on mobile or use a 1-column layout for the balance card.
The tabs row 'Riwayat top up' is clipped at the right edge. It's scrollable but has no visual affordance.

rca of the issue: YouTube duplicate: normalize_url regex r'^(https?)://([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)' discards everything after '?'. For YouTube the video identity lives in the query (?v=ID), so all watch URLs normalize to the same string. Repro: submit https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aaa then https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bbb to a youtube campaign. The second returns 400 'Video ini sudah pernah didaftarkan'. Mitigation: if host is youtube.com and path == '/watch', append '?v=<id>' (or canonicalize to youtu.be/<id>).
